== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Natural treasures are powerful objects or entities that radiate specific types of aura, such as fire, water, earth, blood, dream, or destruction. They vary significantly in strength and quality, with values often determined by an appraisal system ranging from four to sixteen points. These treasures can take many forms, including gemstones, bones, spheres, liquid-filled crystals, or even living elements like an [[ancestral tree]] that produces gold. Some highly specialized items, such as the Heart's Gem or a [[Tear of the Deep]], represent the absolute pinnacle of their respective elemental aspects. These items are often harvested from specific locations, such as the [[Night Wheel Valley]], and can be used for various purposes including training, [[Soulsmithing]], or advancing one's power. When gathered in balanced sets—pairing opposing forces like light and [[Shadow|shadow]] or life and death—they can be used to facilitate significant transformations. Because they can lose potency during transport, they are frequently stored in specialized vaults located near their source of origin. While some treasures are extremely rare or unique, others are traded in mixed sets or used as currency to acquire materials like weapons and constructs. Some treasures are so potent that they must be kept under heavy [[Script|script]] or sealed away to manage their influence on the surrounding environment.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The circle of eight [[natural treasures]] includes a stone head weeping diamond tears radiating [[earth aura]], an old weathervane spinning in the wind, water, fire, life, death, light, and [[Shadow|shadow]].<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c4">''Wintersteel'', chapter 4</ref>}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[natural treasures|Natural treasures]] are worth a minimum of 5 points, subject to appraisal.<ref name="cradle-08-wintersteel-c10">''Wintersteel'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
